models_evaluated: MORPHEUS edge-hosted orchestration pipeline (NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin)

links.outcome: Rubric-based quality of AI vs clinician-authored NICU discharge summaries on same admissions
links.effect: AI scored higher than clinicians: accuracy 0.93 vs 0.75, completeness 0.91 vs 0.67, non-hallucination 0.95 vs 0.78; fewer omissions, unsupported assertions, and contradictions.
links.quote: Error taxonomy analysis demonstrated fewer omissions, unsupported assertions, and contradictions in AI-generated summaries than in clinician-authored summaries.

unlisted_practices: Iterative prompt refinement using omission-derived feedback without model weight updates
LLM-as-judge evaluation guided by a clinician-defined field-level rubric
Edge-hosted local orchestration with cloud LLM inference

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an edge-hosted LLM system (MORPHEUS) for generating NICU discharge summaries from EMR data, and specifically tests the impact of iterative prompt refinement using omission-derived feedback on clinical documentation quality.

primary.practice: iterative prompt refinement based on omission feedback
